# Generated local cache

Aside from this policy file, nothing below this directory is a source-of-truth
file. A fresh clone must be able to recreate every entry.

- `robot_assets/sr12ia/` is generated by `decanting-setup` or
  `decanting-assets` from NVIDIA's FANUC SR-12iA asset. The derived FANUC
  geometry is intentionally not committed because its redistribution is
  governed by the linked FANUC 3D Content Sharing Agreement.
- `robot_descriptions/` is a legacy/download cache. Normal runtime now uses the
  portable, repository-owned UR20 bundle under
  `assets/robots/ur20/official/`.

Run `decanting-setup --accept-fanuc-license` after creating the Conda
environment to prepare and validate a complete workstation. Use
`decanting-setup --sr12ia-usd PATH` when the licensed `geometries.usd` is
already available locally.
